name: atlanai-analytics
description: Answer data questions from governed metrics, use and draft your business ontology, bootstrap metrics and saved SQL queries, build a talk-to-data agent, evaluate it and improve it against your Snowflake or Databricks warehouse, on the Atlan registry.

interface.shortDescription: Metrics and talk-to-data agents on Atlan Trident
interface.longDescription: The analytics workload on the Atlan registry. Ask a data question and get an answer from your published metrics and saved queries, with the definition it used. Mine your warehouse's query history into governed metrics and saved queries, build a talk-to-data agent that reads them, measure it against a local eval set and improve it round by round, or propose a metric fix from a conversation. Ask how business objects relate and which tables hold them, check which policy applied on a date, or draft an ontology for review in Ontology Studio. It finds your Snowflake, Databricks or other warehouse through Atlan or your own connector, and asks you to connect one when it is missing. It uses the Atlan plugin's connection; building and evaluating an agent needs Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: What was revenue last quarter, by region, from our published metrics?
Build metrics and saved queries for our support tables from the warehouse's query history
How do customers join to orders in our business ontology, and which tables hold them?
